name: YINSON
recent: Yinson 近期出现多项 Take-overs & Mergers 相关公告，同时 EPF 与 KWAP 等主要股东持续申报持股变动。公司也披露了董事及高管在闭市期外的 RSU 股份交易。
notable: 公司多次发布 Take-overs & Mergers (Paragraph/Rule 9.19(47A)) 公告。
主要股东 EPF 与 KWAP 在多个交易日申报持股变动。
集团执行主席、集团首席执行官等多名高管因 2026 RSU 获得普通股。
risks: 主要股东 EPF 与 KWAP 的持股变动频繁，需留意股权结构变化。
董事及高管在闭市期外进行股份交易。
earnings: 2026-07-31 季度营收为 MYR 1,136 百万，净利 MYR 128 百万，净利率 11.3%；营收环比增 8.3%、同比减 16.7%，净利环比增 6.7%、同比增 26.7%。

recent_en: Yinson has recently issued multiple Take-overs & Mergers related announcements, while major shareholders such as EPF and KWAP have continued to report changes in their shareholdings. The company also disclosed RSU share dealings by directors and senior management outside the closed period.
notable_en: The company issued multiple Take-overs & Mergers (Paragraph/Rule 9.19(47A)) announcements.
Major shareholders EPF and KWAP reported changes in shareholdings on multiple trading days.
Several senior executives, including the Group Executive Chairman and Group CEO, received ordinary shares under the 2026 RSU.
risks_en: Frequent shareholding changes by major shareholders EPF and KWAP warrant attention to ownership structure changes.
Directors and senior management conducted share dealings outside the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-07-31, revenue was MYR 1,136 million and net income was MYR 128 million, with a net margin of 11.3%; revenue rose 8.3% QoQ but fell 16.7% YoY, while net income grew 6.7% QoQ and 26.7% YoY.
